name: Work Ethics
overview: Scripture teaches that work should be done with wholehearted commitment and diligence, recognizing it as service to the Lord rather than to men (Colossians 3:23). Believers are called to commit their efforts to God, trusting Him to establish their plans (Proverbs 16:3), and to labor with all their might because earthly opportunities are limited (Ecclesiastes 9:10). Our good works are to shine as a testimony that glorifies God (Matthew 5:16), and with greater responsibility comes greater accountability for how we use what God has entrusted to us (Luke 12:48). Even in trials and challenges, God’s presence sustains and protects those who faithfully walk with Him (Isaiah 43:2).
